items.text: Round 3 decisions (D1 BYOK adapter granularity = per-API adapter registry selected by X-Audio-BYOK-Provider; D2 voice mapping = canonical IDs with explicit per-provider overrides; D3 provider precedence = fixed BYOK -> Vrooli -> Local matching BAS) have been synthesized into conclusion.md. A new 'Round 3' block now lives under Settled Decisions and each answered decision has a dedicated finding section.

Conclusion was restructured to stand alone: added a Summary section (TL;DR), promoted provider precedence to its own Finding 10, tightened Findings 8 and 9 to reference their Round 3 resolutions, and added implementation hooks for the BYOK registry (unknown-provider error handling, missing-header error handling).

Verification Paths table now covers F1-F10 with concrete test approaches (registry lookup, unknown-provider error, voice override precedence, fixed chain order with ErrInsufficientCredits short-circuit). Risk Matrix expanded to 9 rows with a new 'Caller confusion from fixed precedence' entry covering the Round 3 D3 trade-off.

Limitations section was pruned: the three 'pending Round 3' unknowns are removed and replaced with follow-ups that are intentionally out of scope (streaming TTS through chain, transparent audio format conversion, per-adapter region config, canonical voice catalog breadth). These do not block downstream execute items and are not research gaps.

Actions section now has three concrete items (LPBS audio gateway endpoints, audio-tools greenfield plan update, BYOK adapter implementations) and no longer contains the Round-3-resolution placeholder action. Confidence Assessment rows for BYOK adapter strategy, voice mapping, provider precedence, and external API options are promoted to High.

No remaining gaps block research closure. Initiative continuous-audio-platform has 9 items; this research is the provider-routing contract that downstream audio-tools and LPBS-gateway execute items consume. Recommended next step: set status=ready and queue for processing.
